channel.title: Vienna Public Transport — Disruptions & Commuter Info
channel.description: Active disruptions, construction works and restrictions from official sources (Wiener Linien, ÖBB, VOR/VAO, City of Vienna).

item.title: U1: Nestroyplatz, ramp lock
item.description: Due to renovation work, is closed at the station Nestroyplatz an entrance. [From Mon 12.10. until 30.11.]
item.content:encoded:
Due to renovation work, is closed at the station Nestroyplatz an entrance.

item.title: U1: Folding ramps out of service on 10.10.2026
item.description: Due to the high passenger volume associated with an event, the folding ramps of the underground trains of line U1 cannot be extended. [On Sat 10.10.]
item.content:encoded:
Due to the high passenger volume associated with an event, the folding ramps of the underground trains of line U1 cannot be extended.
[On Sat 10.10.]

item.title: 18: LCC autumn marathon on 11.10.2026
item.description: Due to the LCC autumn marathon in Prater Hauptallee, line 18 is curtailed. Line 18: service only between Burggasse, Stadthalle U and Schlachthausgasse U. [On Sun 11.10.]
item.content:encoded:
